beats.say: Are you sick and tired of knocking doors all day just for a couple extra deals, when really you want exclusive qualified leads that are ready to buy? Then this is for you.
beats.delivery: Pause before "Then this is for you."

beats.say: We built the exact system you're missing. Here's what I mean.
We build the offer, write the scripts, edit the videos, run your ads, all live within just four days. All of it.
So instead of wondering where next month's jobs are coming from, you're just fulfilling jobs that are already on your calendar.

lock_items: Andy confirms the hook wording by ear (Whisper heard "X to your cleaner still got 20 grand a month").
The guarantee terms for "20 more jobs completely guaranteed" are written on the landing page.
"All live within just four days" is true for a new client.
Andy accepts or fixes each Meta policy scan item above.
meta_scan: MEDIUM: Hook "stuck at 20 grand a month" names the viewer's revenue. Meta's personal-attributes rule rejects ads that imply they know the viewer's financial situation. Safer: "Exterior cleaners who want more booked jobs."
MEDIUM: "$20K A MONTH?" on screen is a money figure. Money on screen can read as an income claim.

MEDIUM: "20 more jobs completely guaranteed ... every single month" is a guarantee. It is a jobs guarantee, not income, but the terms ("booked" means what, which conditions) must exist on the landing page.
